description: IoT HackBot: A collection of Claude Skills and custom tooling for hybrid IoT pentesting

written.description: Works an IoT device from three sides: its companion Android app, its hardware debug and serial interfaces, and the network it sits on. Each hardware skill ships a small Python helper instead of assuming the tool is installed.

alive.last_commit_message:
Add bn-headless skill: headless Binary Ninja decompiler

Headless Binary Ninja CLI (bnhl) for decompiling and reverse-engineering
compiled binaries across any architecture without the GUI. Decompile to
pseudo-C/HLIL/MLIL/disasm, follow xrefs and callees, dump strings and the
code that references them, and enumerate imports/exports/sections. Analysis
is cached per binary for near-instant repeat queries.

Includes the skill, the bnhl CLI script, a PATH shim in bin/, and README
plus plugin keyword updates. Requires a licensed Binary Ninja
(Commercial/Enterprise/Ultimate) with its headless Python API; set
$BN_PYTHON to the install's python dir if it is not in a standard location.
